The University of Texas at Austin is currently determining student eligibility for the Texas B-On Time Loan. Funding for this loan will be extremely limited. For information on this loan program, please visit the Texas Higher Education Co-ordination Board's web-site and read their Texas B-On-Time Loan Fact Sheet. If you have questions, Ask DON!
